## About
Mark Andrew Gros founded MAG Builders in his hometown of Tulsa, Oklahoma, building custom homes. He trained his oldest son, Shawn Andrew Gros, in the family business of home building and remodeling.
Shawn moved to Texas and took that know-how into storm restoration, helping people after devastating storms. After Mark passed away, Shawn carried on his father's legacy by relaunching MAG Builders to serve Texas with custom home building and help for families hit by the storms that too often come through the Lone Star State.
Today we're a residential and commercial construction company in Grapevine, and we specialize in roofing insurance claims and storm damage restoration. We hold a 4.3 rating from 23 Google reviews.

## Services
- Insurance Claims: Our insurance claims specialists work to take the stress out of the storm damage restoration process.
- Free inspection: Call us and we'll come out to inspect your property at no charge.
- Roof replacement: Dakota and the crew replace roofs and take care of the details, from cleanup to follow up.
- Remodeling: Remodeling contractors for your home, big projects or small.
- New Construction: Custom home building is where the family business began.
- Commercial Construction: We build for businesses as well as homeowners.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help me with my insurance claim after a storm?
A: Yes. Our team of insurance claims specialists helps take the stress out of the storm damage restoration process.

Q: Do you charge for an inspection?
A: No. Call us to schedule a free inspection of your property.

Q: Do you offer military discounts or warranties?
A: Yes. We offer military discounts, and warranties are available.

Q: Where are you located?
A: Our office is at 1701 W Northwest Hwy Ste 100 in Grapevine, Texas.
